testCases.title: Successful Customer Login with Valid Credentials

testCases.goal: Verify that a registered user can successfully authenticate and is redirected to the Accounts Overview page
steps: 1. Navigate to ParaBank Welcome page at `https://parabank.parasoft.com/parabank/index.htm`.
2. Verify presence of form `login` with input fields `username`, `password`, and submit button `Log In`.
expected: 1. Welcome page renders with status 200, title 'ParaBank | Welcome | Online Banking'.
2. Form elements `username`, `password`, and submit button `Log In` are visible and enabled.

5. User is redirected to `https://parabank.parasoft.com/parabank/overview.htm`. Left panel displays 'Welcome John Smith' and navigation links (Open New Account, Accounts Overview, Transfer Funds, Bill Pay, Find Transactions, Update Contact Info, Request Loan, Log Out).

expected: 4. Submission fails. URL transitions to `login.htm` error state or displays error message `Please enter a username and password.` in `.error` element. User remains unauthenticated.

testCases.title: Login Failure with Non-Existent Username

testCases.goal: Verify error messaging and security protection when unknown username is supplied
expected: 4. Authentication rejected. Error message `The username and password could not be verified.` or `An internal error has occurred and has been logged.` is displayed in error container. Session is not initiated.

testCases.title: Login Failure with Valid Username and Incorrect Password

testCases.goal: Verify authentication fails when credentials do not match stored hash
expected: 4. Access denied. Error text `The username and password could not be verified.` appears on the page. User is not authenticated.

testCases.title: Boundary Test - Extreme String Lengths in Login Credentials

testCases.goal: Verify buffer handling and input truncation/validation for extreme string lengths
expected: 2. Field accepts up to allowed maximum or truncates gracefully without UI distortion.
3. Password field handles long string securely without crash.
4. Application rejects authentication gracefully with verification error. No HTTP 500 unhandled stack trace is exposed.
